name: flake-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes a failing-check report (with repeated-run evidence) through judge-flake and emits the CHOSEN branch as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures how accurately it separates flaky reds (quarantine) from real regressions (repair). Pair with datasets/flake-calibration.json + evals/flake-calibration.json.
